Package com.smartlostfound.model

Class UserAccount

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.model.User
com.smartlostfound.model.UserAccount
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class UserAccount extends User
User account model representing an authenticated user or administrator. Inherits profile attributes from User and adds credentials and role management.

    • UserAccount

      public UserAccount(String username, String passwordHash, UserRole role, String name, String email, String phone, LocalDateTime createdAt, boolean active)
      Constructs a UserAccount with full credentials and profile details.
      Parameters:
      username - Unique identifier for system authentication
      passwordHash - Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the password
      role - Access control role (USER or ADMIN)
      name - Full legal or display name
      email - Contact email address
      phone - Contact phone number
      createdAt - Account creation timestamp
      active - Account status flag
